headline: FirstEnergy Foundation Supports New Jersey Disaster Preparedness & Recovery with $100,000 Donation to the American Red Cross
summary: Following Jersey Central Power & Light's (JCP&L) comprehensive effort to restore power to customers impacted by four consecutive days of devastating storms, today the FirstEnergy Foundation announced a $100,000 grant to the American Red Cross of New Jersey. The donation extends a long-standing commitment to the Red Cross and its assistance to local residents through emergencies.
